hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.nix) command -v nixfmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && nixfmt "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.nix) if ! out=$(nix-instantiate --parse "$f" 2>&1); then printf 'Nix parse failed for %s:
%s
Fix the syntax error before proceeding.
' "$f" "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac
